items.scope: Vulnerabilities that are discovered, validated, and coordinated through the Hackrate Ethical Hacking Platform, including: software, web applications, APIs, and cloud services; vulnerabilities validated and triaged by our internal security team; and findings disclosed under our coordination that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Synaptics issues only.
Genetec products and solutions only.
